item.title: A46 Closed: Diversion in place southbound – expected closure for considerable time serious collision
item.description: The A46 in Leicestershire remains closed southbound between the A6 (Wanlip) and A5630 (Anstey), due to a serious collision involving 3 cars and a lorry that was reported at 18:00 on the 17/02/26. item.title: Arrest warning after police officer abused in Facebook comments
item.description: People could face arrest after a Derbyshire Police officer was abused on Facebook, the force has warned. item.title: Newark to freeze council tax for 2026 / 27
item.description: Newark and Sherwood District Council’s Cabinet is set to debate the draft budget for 2026/27 on Tuesday 24 February.
